2.211.23
MapColorScale.ZIndex
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapColorScale.ZIndex element specifies the drawing order of a MapColorScale within its
container. This element is optional.
If the MapColorScale.ZIndex element is present, its value MUST be an Integer ([XMLSCHEMA2/2]
section 3.3.17) or an expression that evaluates to an Integer, and its value MUST NOT be negative. If
this element is not present, its value is interpreted as 0.
The following is the parent element of the MapColorScale.ZIndex element.
Parent elements
MapColorScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapColorScale.ZIndex element.
 <xsd:element name="ZIndex" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
